name: Dumbbell Deficit Push-Up
steps: Set two flat-sided dumbbells parallel on the floor just outside shoulder width.
Grip the handles firmly and step your feet back into a straight high plank.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest between the handles as deeply as your shoulders comfortably allow.
Press firmly through both handles to lift your body back to the plank.
tips: Use dumbbells that stay flat and stable under pressure.
Keep your core braced without letting your hips sag or forcing a painful shoulder stretch.
